note: Models dropped from the consensus board. Declared explicitly so the exclusion is auditable: G10 refuses to ignore a model unless it appears here with a reason. Excluded models' raw responses remain in runs/ and are published with the bundle.

excluded.reason: All 3 samples failed I5 ORDER_VIOLATION: emitted "name" before "a1_regulatory" (offset 68 vs 149 in sample 0), i.e. named the division first and supplied anchors afterwards. This is the backwards-rationalisation the field-order rule exists to detect, so the samples are excluded on merit, not on transport failure.

2 of 3 samples failed I5 ORDER_VIOLATION (same failure mode as gemma-4-31b); the model also spends most of its budget on reasoning tokens and truncated at 32000 before max_tokens was raised to 64000. 1 valid sample is below the k>=3 requirement, so the model is excluded from support counts; its single valid sample is retained in the matrix as a 0.33 cell for transparency.

Transport/length failures, not a content judgement: 1 sample truncated at max_tokens 64000 (finish_reason=length) and 2 returned empty SSE streams from the NeuralWatt gateway under concurrent load. A retry is pending; if it yields 3 valid samples this exclusion must be removed and the matrix rebuilt.
